app.name: Ooze Launcher
app.incompatible_backend.title: This launcher build is broken
app.incompatible_backend.body: The launcher's interface and backend don't match (backend API {0}, interface expects {1}). Reinstall Ooze Launcher from the official release.
preview.banner: Developer preview — simulated backend. Nothing here signs in, downloads or starts Minecraft.
first_run.title: Welcome to Ooze
first_run.body: Ooze Launcher installs Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric and Ooze, then starts it for you. First, choose the folder for the game and your worlds.
first_run.location_note: Choose an empty folder or an existing Ooze game folder. Ooze never takes over a folder that already holds other files, and your other Minecraft installations are not touched.
account.sign_in_to_play: Sign in with the Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition.
account.storage_note: Your sign-in is kept in Windows Credential Manager on this PC. Ooze never sees your Microsoft password. Switch account signs in again with the account you pick.
sign_in.browser_help: We opened the Microsoft sign-in page in your web browser. Sign in there, then come back here.
play.instance_mismatch: Select this instance for Play to save its game directory before installing or launching.
install.change_location_note: Changing the folder doesn't move or delete anything. Worlds in the old folder stay there.
install.repair_note: Re-checks every Minecraft, Fabric and Ooze file and replaces damaged ones. Worlds, screenshots, resource packs, shader packs and options are never touched.
install.status.needs_repair: Some game files are missing or damaged
step.waiting_for_browser: Waiting for you to sign in in your browser
step.checking_ownership: Checking that you own Minecraft: Java Edition
game.title_screen: Minecraft is running and reached its title screen.
game.running_note: Close Minecraft normally to return here. Crashes are reported on this page.
notice.cancelled.install: Installation cancelled. Files downloaded so far are kept and reused next time.
notice.game_exited.title: Minecraft closed
notice.game_exited.body_code: It exited with code {0}. The log on the Diagnostics page may explain why.
notice.game_crashed.title: Minecraft crashed
notice.game_crashed.body: Your worlds are saved up to their last autosave. The crash report and log can help find the cause.
notice.game_crashed.body_code: It stopped with exit code {0}. Your worlds are saved up to their last autosave. The crash report and log can help find the cause.
error.auth_not_configured.title: Sign-in isn't set up in this build
error.auth_not_configured.body: This copy of Ooze Launcher was built without a Microsoft application ID, so it can't sign you in. Download Ooze Launcher from the official release page. (Developers: see AUTH_SETUP.md.)
error.auth_app_not_approved.title: Minecraft's services refused this launcher
error.auth_app_not_approved.body: Microsoft accepted your sign-in, but Minecraft's services refused this launcher's application. This usually means the launcher isn't approved for Minecraft yet; nothing is wrong with your account. Until it is, use the official Minecraft Launcher.
error.browser_unavailable.title: Couldn't open your web browser
error.browser_unavailable.body: Sign-in happens in your default web browser. Check that one is installed and set as default, then try again.
error.sign_in_timed_out.title: Sign-in timed out
error.sign_in_timed_out.body: The browser sign-in wasn't finished in time. Try again when you're ready.
error.consent_denied.title: Sign-in was declined
error.consent_denied.body: Ooze needs permission to sign in to Xbox Live to start Minecraft. Try again and choose Accept.
error.no_xbox_profile.title: This account has no Xbox profile
error.no_xbox_profile.body: Sign in once at xbox.com to create one, then try again.
error.xbox_child.title: A parent or guardian needs to allow this
error.xbox_child.body: This is a child account. An adult must add it to a Microsoft family group before it can play.
error.xbox_region.title: Xbox Live isn't available in your region
error.xbox_region.body: Microsoft doesn't offer Xbox Live sign-in for this account's country or region.
error.xbox_banned.title: This account can't use Xbox Live
error.xbox_banned.body: Microsoft has restricted this account. Contact Xbox support for details.
error.not_entitled.title: This account doesn't own Minecraft: Java Edition
error.not_entitled.body: Sign in with the Microsoft account you bought Minecraft: Java Edition with, or buy it at minecraft.net.
error.no_minecraft_profile.title: Choose your Minecraft name first
error.no_minecraft_profile.body: This account owns Minecraft: Java Edition but has no Minecraft name yet. Set one at minecraft.net, then sign in again.
error.session_expired.title: Please sign in again
error.session_expired.body: Your saved sign-in has expired or was revoked.
error.offline.title: Can't reach the internet
error.offline.body: Check your connection and try again. Files already downloaded are kept.
error.service_unavailable.title: A Microsoft or Minecraft service isn't responding
error.service_unavailable.body: This is usually temporary. Try again in a few minutes.
error.rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
error.rate_limited.body: The service asked us to slow down. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.path_not_writable.title: Ooze can't write to that folder
error.path_not_writable.body: Choose a folder you own, for example in your user folder, or check its permissions.
error.path_invalid.title: That folder can't be used
error.path_invalid.body: Choose an existing local folder, not a system folder or a network path.
error.path_inside_install.title: That folder is inside another game installation
error.path_inside_install.body: To keep your other installations safe, choose a folder outside them.
error.disk_full.title: Not enough disk space
error.disk_full.body: Free up space on that drive or choose another install location, then try again.
error.files_in_use.title: Some files are in use
error.files_in_use.body: Close Minecraft and any program using the install folder, then try again.
error.checksum.title: Some downloads were damaged
error.checksum.body: A file didn't match its expected checksum after several tries. Repair downloads it again.
error.java_not_found.title: Java wasn't found there
error.java_not_found.body: Choose java.exe or javaw.exe inside a Java 21 installation, or use the managed Java.
error.java_wrong_version.title: That Java isn't version 21
error.java_wrong_version.body: Minecraft 1.21.11 needs Java 21. Choose a Java 21 installation or use the managed Java.
error.java_not_64bit.title: That Java is 32-bit
error.java_not_64bit.body: Choose a 64-bit Java 21, or use the managed Java.
error.not_signed_in.title: Sign in to play
error.not_signed_in.body: Minecraft needs a signed-in Microsoft account that owns it.
error.not_installed.title: Minecraft isn't installed yet
error.not_installed.body: Install it first; it takes a few minutes.
error.already_running.title: Minecraft is already running
error.already_running.body: Only one copy can run from this launcher at a time.
error.busy.title: Ooze is busy
error.busy.body: Wait for the current task to finish, then try again.
error.process_start.title: Minecraft couldn't start
error.process_start.body: Java didn't start. Try Repair; if it keeps failing, export diagnostics from the Diagnostics page.
error.internal.title: Something went wrong
error.internal.body: Ooze hit an unexpected problem. Export diagnostics from the Diagnostics page to report it.
settings.memory.label: Memory for Minecraft
settings.while_playing.label: Launcher window
settings.java.label: Java runtime
settings.java.managed_note: Ooze downloads and verifies a Java 21 runtime inside the install location.
settings.java.custom_note: Choose a 64-bit Java 21 and check it before saving.
settings.a11y.motion_note: Reduced replaces movement with short fades. Off makes every change instant.
settings.unsaved_game_running: You have unsaved changes. Save them after Minecraft closes.
about.profile: Profile: Minecraft {0}, Fabric Loader {1}, Fabric API {2}, Ooze {3}
about.fonts: Bubblegum Sans (Sudtipos) and Inter (The Inter Project Authors) are used under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
about.not_affiliated: Ooze is not an official Minecraft product and is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
diag.redaction_note: Sign-in tokens and personal folder names are removed from everything shown, copied or exported here.
close.game_running.title: Minecraft is still running
close.game_running.body: Minecraft keeps running if you close the launcher, but crashes won't be reported here.
close.sign_in.title: Sign-in is in progress
close.install.title: Installation is in progress
close.install.body: Closing cancels it. Files downloaded so far are kept and reused next time.
close.launch.title: Minecraft is starting
close.launch.body: Minecraft may still open after the launcher closes, but crashes won't be reported here.
install.status.checked_on_play: Ooze installs and verifies the game files when you press Play.
settings.java.checked_on_play: Ooze checks that this is a 64-bit Java 21 when you press Play.
app.startup.unsupported.title: Ooze Launcher needs Windows
app.startup.unsupported.body: This version of Ooze Launcher runs on 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 only.
app.startup.busy.title: Ooze Launcher is already running
app.startup.busy.body: Another Ooze Launcher window is using the same data folder. Switch to it, or close it and start Ooze Launcher again.
app.startup.failed.title: Ooze Launcher couldn't start
app.startup.failed.body: Its settings or data folder couldn't be read. Nothing was changed. The details below say what went wrong.
step.authorizing: Signing in to Microsoft, Xbox Live and Minecraft
error.unsupported_platform.title: Not supported on this computer
error.unsupported_platform.body: This version runs on 64-bit Windows only.
error.configuration.title: That setting can't be used
error.configuration.body: Check the install location, Java and memory settings.
error.io.title: Ooze couldn't read or write its files
error.io.body: Check free disk space and folder permissions, then try again.
error.network.title: Network problem
error.network.body: Check your connection and try again. Files already downloaded are kept.
error.authentication.title: Sign-in couldn't be completed
error.authentication.body: Microsoft or Xbox sign-in didn't finish. Sign in again; the details below name the step that failed.
error.metadata.title: Version information couldn't be used
error.metadata.body: This launcher package may be damaged. Download it again from the official release.
error.java_runtime.title: Java problem
error.java_runtime.body: Ooze needs a 64-bit Java 21. Use the managed Java or choose another installation.
error.credential_store.title: Windows couldn't store your sign-in
error.credential_store.body: Windows Credential Manager refused the request. Try again or restart your PC.
error.service_denied.title: A Minecraft or Xbox service refused the request
error.service_denied.body: The service didn't allow this request. Try again later. If it keeps happening, export the log from Diagnostics.
instance.ooze_unavailable_long: Ooze modules are not available for this instance. It plays as a plain instance.
instances.intro: Each instance has its own game version, loader, files and content. Worlds and settings stay inside their instance.
instances.name: Name
instances.name.invalid: Enter a name of 1 to 48 characters.
instances.only_supported: Only combinations this launcher can install and verify are listed.
instances.running_locked: Close this instance's game to change it.
instances.duplicate.name: {0} (copy)
instances.duplicate.confirm_body: Copies the configuration and the content Ooze installed. Worlds, screenshots and game options are not copied.
instances.archive.confirm_body: The instance moves to the library archive with all its files. Nothing is deleted.
integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.custom.body: Content downloads are hash-checked. Ooze makes no fair-play statement about this instance.
integrity.managed.body: This instance is checked against Ooze's release manifest: only approved files and settings. This describes your installation; each server decides what it allows.
integrity.limits: Checks run on this computer and identify files by their hashes. They can't tell whether a server allows something, and they can't stop someone from changing their own files.
integrity.ok: No problems found in {0} checked files.
integrity.never_deleted: Ooze never deletes files for you. Choose what to do with each one.
integrity.problem.hash: This file doesn't match the expected version.
integrity.problem.unexpected_mod: This mod isn't part of the managed set.
integrity.problem.unapproved_pack: This pack isn't approved for Managed Fair Play.
integrity.problem.launch_setting: A launch setting isn't allowed in Managed Fair Play: {0}.
integrity.resolved.body: The report below is up to date.
integrity.to_custom.title: Switch this instance to Custom?
integrity.to_custom.body: Your files stay as they are. Ooze stops checking them against the release manifest.
integrity.to_managed.title: Switch this instance to Managed Fair Play?
integrity.to_managed.body: Ooze will check this instance against its release manifest and list anything that doesn't match. Nothing is removed automatically.
library.busy_hint: Another library task is running. Actions are available again when it finishes.
library.error.busy.title: Another library task is running
library.error.busy.body: Wait for it to finish, then try again.
library.error.game_running.title: Close Minecraft for this instance first
library.error.game_running.body: This change can't be made while the instance's game is running.
library.error.incompatible.title: Not compatible with this instance
library.error.conflict.title: This conflicts with installed content
library.error.hash.title: The download didn't match Modrinth's checksum
library.error.hash.body: It wasn't installed. Try again later.
library.error.rate_limited.title: Modrinth asked us to slow down
library.error.offline.title: Couldn't reach Modrinth
library.error.offline.body: Check your internet connection and try again.
library.error.not_found.title: Not found
library.error.not_found.body: It may have been removed. Search again.
library.error.config.title: Library data couldn't be read
library.error.invalid.title: That wasn't accepted
library.error.invalid.body: The library checked the values and refused them. Nothing was saved.
library.error.stale.title: This changed somewhere else
library.error.stale.body: The latest version is shown now. Make your change again.
library.error.internal.title: Something went wrong in the library
library.error.internal.body: Nothing was changed. Export the log from Diagnostics if it keeps happening.
profile.intro: Modules, HUD and visual settings for {0}.
profile.presets.intro: A preset is a starting point. Your own changes are kept when you switch.
profile.preset.fps.description: Shows FPS and frame time and turns down Ooze's own effects. It doesn't install performance mods or promise a higher frame rate.
profile.preset.pvp.description: Combat information: FPS, armour, effects, keystrokes, CPS, ping and a clear crosshair.
profile.preset.minimal.description: No HUD modules and calm interface effects.
profile.switch.title: Switch to {0}?
profile.modules.intro: Modules show information or change visuals. None of them plays for you.
profile.server_sensitive: Some servers don't allow this. Check a server's rules before using it.
profile.color.invalid: Enter a colour as # followed by 8 hexadecimal digits.
profile.hud.in_game: Move and resize HUD modules in game with the HUD editor.
profile.saved.body: It applies the next time this instance starts.
profile.reset_all.confirm_body: Every module, HUD and visual setting returns to the preset.
content.shader.title: Shader packs need a shader loader
content.shader.body: A shader loader mod (for example Iris) must be installed in this instance. The install review shows whether one is present. Installing a pack doesn't turn it on.
content.datapack.no_worlds.title: No worlds in this instance
content.datapack.no_worlds.body: Data packs install into a world. Create a world in this instance first.
content.datapack.choose_world: Choose the world to install into.
content.datapack.game_running: Close the game to install data packs.
content.compat_note: Compatible with {0}, as reported by Modrinth.
content.author: by {0}
content.no_compatible_version: No version is compatible with this instance.
content.plan.title: Install review
content.plan.loader_unavailable.body: The library can't install a shader loader for this instance, so this pack can't be used here.
content.plan.conflict.body: Remove or disable the installed item first. Nothing will be installed while a conflict remains.
content.plan.verified_note: Every file is checked against Modrinth's SHA-512 checksum before it's added.
content.installed.title: Installed and verified
content.installed.hint.mod: It loads the next time this instance starts.
content.installed.hint.resourcepack: Turn it on in Options → Resource Packs in game.
content.installed.hint.datapack: It takes effect the next time this world is loaded.
content.installed.hint.shader: Turn it on in the shader loader's settings in game.
content.installed.none: Nothing of this type installed yet.
content.remove.confirm_body: Removes {0}. Other files in the instance are not touched.
appearance.intro: How the launcher looks. Changes show straight away; Apply keeps them.
appearance.accent.bad_hex: Enter a colour as # followed by 6 hexadecimal digits.
appearance.accent.low_text: Text on it would reach only {0}:1; 4.5:1 is needed.
appearance.accent.low_canvas: It stands out from the background by only {0}:1; 3:1 is needed.
appearance.preview.title: Sample card
appearance.import.unknown_base: It's based on a theme this launcher doesn't have.
